optimizedContext.value:
# Guide Domain Model

Domain types backing catalog lookups, outline inspection, section slicing, search.

## Rules

### GuideTopic (entity)
- `topic`: canonical id = source filename w/o extension (`getting-started`).
- `title`, `description`: frontmatter strings.
- `order`: numeric sort idx (`sidebar_position`).
- `content`: markdown body, frontmatter stripped.
- `lineCount`: lines in `content`. `byteLength`: UTF-8 bytes of `content`.
- `outline`: `GuideSection[]`.

### GuideSection (value object)
- `index`: 1-indexed position in doc outline. `heading`: text, no leading `#`.
- `level`: heading depth 1..6.
- `startLine` / `endLine`: 1-indexed, inclusive.
- `lines`: `endLine - startLine + 1`.
- `startOffset` / `endOffset`: 0-indexed char offsets into parent `content`.
- `content?`: optional / on-demand; heading line through `endLine`.

### GuideSummary (value object)
- `topic`, `title`, `description`, `order`, `lineCount`, `byteLength`.
- Lean catalog row: no `content`, no `outline`.

### GuideOutline (value object)
- `topic`, `file`, `lines`, `bytes`, `sections: readonly GuideSection[]`.

### GuideSearchHit (value object)
- `topic`, `file`, `section` (heading text), `sectionIndex`, `level`, `startLine`, `endLine`.
- `score` (BM25), `snippet` (line-numbered), `readCommand`.
- `readCommand` = `specd guide <topic> --section <sectionIndex>` (index form, not heading).

## Constraints

- Pure TS types / immutable classes; no runtime deps.
- All line numbers 1-indexed positive ints; `level` 1..6.
- `GuideTopic.outline` and `GuideOutline.sections` are `readonly GuideSection[]`.

## `file` Semantics (code-verified)

- `GuideOutline.file` and `GuideSearchHit.file` are **synthesized plain filenames** `${topic}.md` — NOT real source paths.
- Sources: `packages/guide/src/application/queries/get-guide-outline-query.ts:38`; `packages/guide/src/infrastructure/adapters/minisearch-guide-engine-adapter.ts:290`.
- Both typed bare `string`; JSDoc/spec say only "Source filename" — no path or collection carrier.
- Blocker for `sdk-development-guide`: multi-directory bundling needs the real source path here. `collection:topic` addressing (`core:ports`, `sdk:index`) yields `core:ports.md`, which is not a real file. Needs a new field or a redefinition of `file`.
